HOSPITAL MEDICINE ADMISSION NOTE
CHIEF COMPLAINT: Right flank pain, fever

HPI: 65F with recurrent UTIs. Started nitrofurantoin 100 mg PO BID on 06/03/2024 for a 5-day course, completed 06/07/2024. Now with fever, flank pain.

ASSESSMENT/PLAN: Pyelonephritis. Start ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily.

ADMISSION H&P
CC: Cough, dyspnea

HPI: 72M with COPD. Urgent care prescribed azithromycin 500 mg daily x5 days starting 03/14/2024, finished 03/18/2024. Also took amoxicillin, which he is still taking, since 03/17/2024.

A/P: CAP, start ceftriaxone + azithromycin.

ADMISSION NOTE
CC: Fall, weakness

HPI: 81F found down at home. No recent antibiotics. Denies fevers.

A/P: Mechanical fall, rule out infection.

ADMISSION H&P
CC: Fever, cellulitis

HPI: 54M. Cephalexin 500 mg QID 10/01/2023 to 10/10/2023, then cephalexin again 11/20/2023 to present for recurrent leg cellulitis. Also received colistin inhalation in October (dates unknown).

A/P: Failed outpatient therapy, start vancomycin.

PROGRESS NOTE (hospital day 3)
Continuing vancomycin. Not the admission note: outside the 24 h window, so the task skips it.

ADMISSION H&P
CC: Diarrhea

HPI: 60F. Took ciprofloxacin some time last year; no dates. Doxycycline 100 mg BID for 7 days, ended about two months ago.

A/P: C. diff testing.
